podcast.body: Glenn Frey died on January 18, 2016, due to complications from intestinal surgery. "January 18th, Glenn Fry of the Eagles, complications from intestinal surgery."

podcast.title: Death in 2016
podcast.body: Glen Frey of the Eagles was among the significant figures in rock who passed away in 2016, a year noted for its substantial number of musical losses. "David Bowie, Prince, Glen Fry of the Eagles, two members of the Jefferson Airplane, Matt Roberts of Three Doors Down, George Michael, Beatles producer George Martin, Keith Emerson and Greg Lake of Emerson, like in Palmer, Maurice White of Earth Wind and Fire and dozens more."

podcast.title: Early Supporter of "Beautiful Loser"
podcast.body: Glenn Frey of Eagles was the first person to hear Bob Seger's song "Beautiful Loser" and encouraged him to record it. This endorsement was significant in the song's journey to becoming a track on Seger's 1975 album of the same name. "The first person to hear it who said you should record that was Glenn Fry of Eagles."

podcast.title: Formation of The Eagles
podcast.body: Glen Frey, along with Don Henley, was a member of Linda Ronstadt's band before they went on to form the hugely successful band The Eagles. "We know now just how huge Glen Fry and Don Henley who were in her band would become when they formed the Eagles."

podcast.title: Influenced by The Flying Burrito Brothers
podcast.body: Glenn Frey, a founding member of The Eagles, was a regular attendee at The Flying Burrito Brothers' performances at The Troubadour in Los Angeles. Their music, particularly the album "Gilded Palace of Sin," had a significant influence on him and subsequently on the Eagles. "Glenn Fry, who Hillman said was a regular in the crowd at the Trubidor in Los Angeles where the burritos played."

podcast.title: Linda Ronstadt's Hall of Fame Induction Speech
podcast.body: Glenn Fry of The Eagles gave the induction speech for Linda Ronstadt when she was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2014. He had been a member of her backing band, along with Don Henley, before they went on to form The Eagles. "Glenn Fry of the Eagles gave her induction speech."

podcast.title: Meeting at The Troubadour
podcast.body: Glenn Frey met Linda Ronstadt and Don Henley at The Troubadour bar, a significant encounter that subsequently led to the formation of The Eagles. "I met Bernie Leiden and G. Glenn Fry and Don Henley. I met them at the troubadour bar."
